accountPage.title: Delete your Hamkke account
accountPage.intro: Here's how to delete your Hamkke account and data. Deletion happens right away and can't be undone.
accountPage.step2: Tap your photo in the top right to open Settings.
accountPage.step3: Tap "Delete account" at the bottom and confirm. If you're already signed in, you can also delete it below.
accountPage.deletedBody: Your account (name, email and sign-in details) and everything in the space you share — chats, photos, voice messages, plans, anniversaries, capsules, location history and flights — for both of you. If you're subscribed, it's canceled right away and you won't be charged again. Your partner's account stays, so they can connect again.
accountPage.keptBody: Payment records such as receipts are kept by our payment provider (Stripe) for the period the law requires. We don't keep anything else.
